description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests related to user details in the vtiger CRM system, including updating user information and validating certain fields like Asterisk extensions.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: A class representing user entities in vtiger CRM, providing methods for retrieving and saving user information.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Fetches user entity info from the database given a user ID and module name.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current user object state to the database.

methods.name: getHomeStuffOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the order and visibility of user's home page widgets.
